    • VkCopyBufferInfo2KHR

      public VkCopyBufferInfo2KHR(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a VkCopyBufferInfo2KHR instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
